17031.leakage_rule: Assessor 'mailed' (first-pass, pre-appeal) values of an assessment year strictly before the sale's calendar year. Cook's model for year Y is built from earlier sales, and the mailed value precedes any appeal that could cite the sale.

filters.description: Assessor class 202-210, 234, 278 or 295 (classes whose improvement records are >= 99% 'Single-Family')
Sale price >= $10,000 and not flagged by the Assessor's sale_filter_less_than_10k
Warranty or Trustee deed and not flagged by the Assessor's sale_filter_deed_type (drops quit-claim, executor, 'Other' and similar)
Not a multi-parcel sale (is_multisale false, num_parcels_sale = 1)
Not flagged sale_filter_same_sale_within_365 (same parcel sold again within a year)
Duplicate records of one sale collapsed; if more than 8000 sales remain, the 8000 with the lowest FNV-1a hash of parcel+document are kept
Improvement record for the roll year before the sale says char_use 'Single-Family' with exactly one building card

A pre-sale assessment exists under the leakage rule: Assessor 'mailed' (first-pass, pre-appeal) values of an assessment year strictly before the sale's calendar year. Cook's model for year Y is built from earlier sales, and the mailed value precedes any appeal that could cite the sale.
Parcel located inside one of the county bundle's block groups
Sale price >= $25,000 (the floor runCountyValuationBacktest scores; keeps engine and baselines on the same sales)

sample.split: by parcel (FNV-1a hash of the parcel id); every metric below is on the evaluation half

assessor_ratio.description: Pre-sale assessor value x median(sale price / pre-sale assessor value) of the calibration half

prior_sale_hpi.description: Prior recorded sale x FHFA all-transactions HPI change for metro division 16984 (index at the prior sale's quarter -> latest quarter ended >= 90 days before the sale)

engine_calibrated.description: Same engine with the county calibration below passed in (calibration input): assessor value x county ratio, prior sale x FHFA metro HPI, hedonic x county scale, blended with weights from each component's calibration-half error. Fitted on the calibration half; measured on the evaluation half.

calibration.fitted_on: calibration half (3867 sales, disjoint parcels from the evaluation half)

engine_with_county_scale.description: Shipped engine output x one county-wide scale factor fitted on the calibration half (median sale / estimate). Shows how much of the error is a level bias.
